title: The Witness - A Great Game That You Shouldn't Play
summary: Joseph Anderson's long critique of Jonathan Blow's puzzle game The Witness, covering its gameplay, its hundreds of puzzles and its philosophical pretensions. He argues it is a great game that he nonetheless advises against playing.
why: HN uses it mainly as a critical review of the game, saying it captures a lack of respect for the player, though one commenter suggests watching it after finishing.

quote.text: I think this was a fair critique of the Witness and why it lacks respect for the player
